summary: Vermilion Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results. The press release highlights production, financials, net debt reduction, increased production guidance, and an enhanced return of capital framework targeting 40-60% of excess free cash flow. It also notes a closed acquisition of German assets subsequent to the quarter. This is a routine earnings report and operational update, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. No board recommendation, deal terms, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. The filing is standard for a foreign private issuer and does not trigger special-situations classification.
